jobs.name: blocked-card-24h-soak-monitor
jobs.prompt:
Run the blocked-card 24h soak monitor audit script and report findings.

Script: /home/frank/.hermes/profiles/test-engineer/scripts/blocked_card_soak_monitor.py

The script audits the production jarvis-os kanban DB for any blocked→running transitions without a legitimate unblock path (unblocked/promoted_manual/promoted events) since the fix deployment. It returns SILENT when clean, or VIOLATION: lines when violations are found.

1. Run the script: python3 /home/frank/.hermes/profiles/test-engineer/scripts/blocked_card_soak_monitor.py
2. Capture the full output (stdout + stderr) and exit code.
3. If exit code is 0 (SILENT/clean): report that the soak check passed with the [INFO] line timestamp.
4. If exit code is 1 (VIOLATIONS found): THIS IS CRITICAL — report the full violation list immediately.
5. If exit code is anything else (script error/DB unavailable): report the error for investigation.
6. If violations are found, create a new bug card on the jarvis-os board with title "REGRESSION: blocked card dispatched without unblock in soak", body containing the violation evidence.

Report the result concisely. This task is part of the 24-hour blocked-card soak verification.
